## Overview

Plannerly combines BIM standards, workflows, and deliverables into a single collaborative platform. It supports the creation and management of BIM Execution Plans (BEPs) and aligns teams with leading industry frameworks such as ISO 19650.

With Plannerly, project teams streamline information management, reduce risk, and improve collaboration across owners, consultants, and contractors.

* * *

## Key Features

### 1\. BIM Execution Planning (BEP)

Create structured, compliant BEPs using drag-and-drop templates. Set clear expectations across teams, including legal agreements, workflows, and defined responsibilities.

### 2\. Visual Scoping

Define project scope visually using intuitive tools. Plannerly supports frameworks such as AIA, BIM Forum, and ISO 19650 to align deliverables, roles, and responsibilities.

### 3\. Automated BIM Compliance

Automated compliance checks support over 60 model file formats, including Revit and IFC. Models can be validated against project-specific requirements before delivery.

### 4\. Integrated Collaboration

Stakeholders can co-author, review, comment on, and approve documents in real time. This eliminates version control issues and accelerates decision-making.

### 5\. eSignature Workflow

Integrated electronic signatures enable secure, formal approvals within the platform, reducing delays and manual processing.

* * *

## Global Reach and Adoption

Plannerly is trusted by nearly 150,000 teams across 100+ countries, including organizations such as AECOM and Foster + Partners. It is widely used to improve BIM coordination, transparency, and accountability on complex projects.

* * *

## Educational Access

Plannerly offers free access for students and academic institutions to support industry development and hands-on BIM management learning.
